{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check that revenue is string and has commas
print("Sample of revenue strings:")
print(df_completed['revenue'].head())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"\nMean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")

# Check for any remaining sentinel values
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue_clean = 999999.99: {(df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()}")"}
